name: GitHub: Shared Self-Hosted Runners Can Intercept Secret-Bearing Jobs
query:
MATCH p=(runner:GH_Runner)-[:GH_CanInterceptJob]->(job:GH_WorkflowJob)-[:GH_CanAccessSecret]->(secret:GH_Secret)
WHERE runner:GH_OrgRunner
OR runner:GH_EnterpriseRunner
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000
description: Returns organization- and enterprise-scoped self-hosted runners that can intercept workflow jobs with statically resolvable secret access. Shared runners are especially important to review because compromise can expose execution contexts across multiple repositories.
